name: SCARAB
blurb: South Carolina's annual board game convention at the SC State Museum in Columbia: open gaming, RPGs, TCGs and a board game library.

editions.evidence: Key art and page text (via scarabcon.com, which redirects to its registration page on tabletop.events): 'SCARAB CON ... January 15-17 Columbia, SC South Carolina Museum'; 'Dates Fri, Jan 15 2027 ... Sun, Jan 17 2027'; venue 'The SC State Museum, 301 Gervais St, Columbia, SC 29201, USA'

notes: scarabcon.com is the con's own domain (named in its own key art, 'www.scarabcon.com') but 302-redirects to its tabletop.events listing, which is where SCARAB actually runs registration, schedule and venue info; used as url since it's the promoted official domain. tabletop.events hosts a year-stamped page per edition (scarab-2026 already ran Jan 2026, before today; scarab-2027 is the upcoming edition, Jan 15-17 2027). No 'Guests' nav item or guest-of-honor page on either year's site (nav is just Home/Attend/Exhibit-Sponsor/News) -- this is an open-gaming/library-focused tabletop con with no celebrity guest program, so guests is 'none'. No organizer entity is named anywhere on the site (only the venue, SC State Museum, and the Tabletop.Events/BoardGameGeek platform footer), so organizer is left blank rather than guessed.
